title: Achieving an $O(1/N)$ Optimality Gap in Average-Reward Weakly-Coupled MDPs
abstract: arXiv:2609.38132v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study average-reward weakly-coupled Markov decision processes (WCMDPs), where a WCMDP consists of $N$ smaller MDPs, called arms, that share multiple per-step budget constraints. We consider the setting where the arms have identical model parameters, multiple actions, and state- and action-dependent costs. For restless bandits (RBs), a well-studied special case of WCMDPs, prior work has developed policies that achieve an $O(1/\sqrt{N})$ optimality gap under general conditions, and has further identified conditions under which policies can achieve a better-than-$1/\sqrt{N}$ optimality gap. However, for general WCMDPs, no prior result achieves an optimality gap better than $1/\sqrt{N}$. In this paper, we identify conditions analogous to those for RBs under which a better-than-$1/\sqrt{N}$ optimality gap is achievable, and design a policy that attains an $O(1/N)$ optimality gap. Notably, unlike prior approaches based on generalizing prior

translated_title: 在平均报酬弱耦合马尔可夫决策过程中实现 $O(1/N)$ 的最优性差距
translated_abstract: 我们研究平均报酬弱耦合马尔可夫决策过程（WCMDP），其中一个WCMDP由$N$个较小的MDP（称为“臂”）组成，这些臂共享多个每步预算约束。我们考虑各臂具有相同模型参数、多种动作以及依赖于状态和动作的成本的设置。对于不休息强盗问题（RB）——WCMDP的一个被广泛研究的特例——先前的工作已在一般条件下开发出能够实现 $O(1/\sqrt{N})$ 最优性差距的策略，并进一步确定了策略能够实现优于 $1/\sqrt{N}$ 最优性差距的条件。然而，对于一般的WCMDP，此前没有任何结果能够实现优于 $1/\sqrt{N}$ 的最优性差距。在本文中，我们确定了与RB类似的可实现优于 $1/\sqrt{N}$ 最优性差距的条件，并设计了一种达到 $O(1/N)$ 最优性差距的策略。值得注意的是，与先前基于推广的方法不同……
tldr: 本文首次针对一般平均报酬弱耦合马尔可夫决策过程（WCMDP）识别出可实现优于 $1/\sqrt{N}$ 最优性差距的条件，并设计出一种达到 $O(1/N)$ 最优性差距的策略，突破了此前WCMDP仅能达到 $1/\sqrt{N}$ 差距的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies conditions under which a better-than-$1/\sqrt{N}$ optimality gap is achievable for general average-reward weakly-coupled MDPs and designs a policy attaining an $O(1/N)$ optimality gap, the first such improvement beyond restless bandits.
